note: FILIP1 mediates FLNc degradation, and muscle biopsy of a patient with a FILIP1 missense variant showed accumulation of FLNc and myofibrillar disintegration.

evidence.text: In a patient harbouring a homozygous FILIP1 missense variant (p.Pro1133Leu), muscle biopsy analysis revealed core-like zones of myofibrillar disintegration, autophagic vacuoles, and accumulation of filamin C (FLNc), accompanied by dysregulation of proteostasis.

source.title: Bi-allelic variants of FILIP1 cause congenital myopathy, dysmorphism and neurological defects
source.quote: Electron and immunofluorescence microscopy on the muscle biopsy derived from the patient harbouring the homozygous p.[Pro1133Leu] missense variant revealed core-like zones of myofibrillar disintegration, autophagic vacuoles and accumulation of FLNc.

evidence.text: Dephosphorylation of FLNc at domain 20 facilitates binding to FILIP1, which acts as a mediator for filamin degradation in muscle cells.

source.title: Protein phosphatase-1 regulates the binding of filamin C to FILIP1 in cultured skeletal muscle cells under mechanical stress
source.quote: FLNc-pS2234 dephosphorylation promotes the interaction with FILIP1, a mediator for filamin degradation.
